column7: The auth.sso_login audit event (SAML ACS and OIDC callback) records the same client address its session records, clientIP(r) as resolved by the ClientIP middleware (trusted-proxy aware); it used to carry an empty IP. OIDC sibling: TestCompleteSSO_LoginAuditRecordsTheSessionsClientIPBehindTrustedProxy. The SAML per-IP budget (sso_begin, BeginSAML) is keyed by the forwarded client too: TestBeginSAML_BudgetKeyIsTheForwardedClientBehindTrustedProxy (same file). SAML-TAILS-1 item 1.
